The Junction supplies specialist hardware and software for data connectivity, embedded computing, air traffic control, voice recording and rugged display systems across Europe and Scandinavia. Browse products Contact us Based in Drammen, Norway Serving Europe and Scandinavia Experience 30+ years in specialist technology Application areas Solutions that keep critical data moving All products → 01 Embedded Computing NVIDIA Jetson carrier boards and rugged edge AI systems, COM Express and COM-HPC carriers, VPX, GPU/GPGPU, camera platforms and thermal solutions. 02 Connectivity Serial-to-Ethernet device servers, serial cards and I/O, terminal servers and secure remote access to serial equipment. 03 IT Infrastructure Fiber media converters, Ethernet extenders, industrial managed switches, PoE, console servers for out-of-band management and LTE/5G routers. 04 Monitors & Panels Sealed, sunlight-readable LCD monitors from 6.5" to 42", panel PCs and consoles for marine, industrial and defence use, rugged power supplies. 05 Air Traffic Control Rugged compute, synchronous and asynchronous serial connectivity, media conversion and networking for ATC and radar data infrastructure. 06 Unified Communications VoIP gateways, session border controllers, telephony interfaces and tools for connected voice and data systems. 07 TDM Voice Recording Interfaces for compliance call recording: passive taps, TDM and analog recording boards, audio and metadata streamers. Ask for current availability. Manufacturers Specialists behind every solution Guelph, Canada · Elite NVIDIA Jetson partner Carrier boards, rugged edge AI systems and camera platforms for the full NVIDIA Jetson range, plus COM Express, COM-HPC, VPX and Ethernet switch products.
